scenes.label: sign-in
scenes.line: Enter your email, and we'll send you a four digit code to verify it.

scenes.label: dashboard
scenes.line: From your dashboard, tap New Order to begin.

scenes.label: new-order
scenes.line: Your new order starts out empty, so add a person to it first.

scenes.label: add-party-member
scenes.line: You can add yourself, or invite a party member.

scenes.label: member-added
scenes.line: That person is on the list now.

scenes.label: item-catalogue
scenes.line: Search the catalogue, or open a collection to see the items inside it.

scenes.label: pick-the-dates
scenes.line: Choose your pickup date, then your return date. {0.3} For a one-day rental, tap the same day twice.

scenes.label: item-on-the-order
scenes.line: Your item is on the order.

scenes.label: the-questions
scenes.line: Answer a few questions so we can have your gear ready before you get here. {0.3} Tell us your height, your boot size, your skill level, your weight and your age. {0.3} Then agree to the terms and complete the questionnaire.

scenes.label: checkout
scenes.line: Enter your card details to finish the rental.

scenes.label: back-to-dashboard
scenes.line: Your rental now shows in your order history, ready for your next visit.
